Builds the analytic cohort with `flowchart` [@flowchart_pkg]. Every exclusion is one `fc_filter()` step in the order of section 4 of the analysis plan, so the flow diagram (Figure 1) is the cohort. Who is studied, and why each exclusion is made, is on [Who is studied](study_cohort.qmd).

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/create_cohort.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/create_cohort.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/link_area_data.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/link_area_data.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/create_cohort.R")
```

## Labels

```{r}
#| label: define-flowchart-labels
```

## Exclusions

Each of the 17 steps is one `fc_filter()` call, in the order of section 4 of the [analysis plan](analysis-plan.qmd#4-study-population); the reason for each is on [Who is studied](study_cohort.qmd#exclusions-in-order). Steps 11 and 12 are one step in the plan, drawn as two boxes so that each loss is counted.

In the original code the cohort was filtered in about 27 separate places, and a hand-maintained table recorded the counts. The table and the data drifted apart: one exclusion was recorded as removing nobody while the next line removed patients; at least eight filters (including the facility linkage) were never recorded; two rows were labelled with the wrong variable; and one recorded step was never applied. Here each step both filters and counts, so the diagram cannot disagree with the data.

```{r}
#| label: build-flowchart
#| eval: false
```

## Notes on the code

`flowchart` turns each condition into text and evaluates it again in its own environment, so a condition can use only columns of the data and constants that `main.R` has put in the global environment from `setup.R`, never objects local to a function.
